getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.player: Hello. Do you need any help? I'm looking for a quest.
Uh, I'm not sure. Who are they?
Seriously, what are you talking about?

getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.speaker: Larry
getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.text: I think you can be trusted. What do you know about...

getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.player: Uh...they live in the cold? That's about all.

getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.speaker: Larry
getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.text: Would you like to learn more about them? I'm conducting a, uh, research project, to, uh, learn about their social habits in their natural environment.

getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.player: What do you need my help for?

getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.speaker: Larry
getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.text: Well, I need to build a shelter to hide from view, and it's always useful to have an extra pair of eyes, you know, for, uh, observing...Penguins.

getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.speaker: Larry
getting-started-speaking-to-larry-at-ard.text: So, are you up for it?

steps.player: Okay, why not! But first, who are you and why are you researching penguins?

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: I, uh, was a zoo keeper here. But, I, uh, am on leave to go research penguins in their native habitat.

steps.player: Ok! Okay then. So, what did you need me to do?

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: Right. I need you to gather materials for the bird hide, while I arrange for our transport.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: You need to get 10 oak planks, 10 steel nails, a hammer, and a spade so that we can build a bird hide.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: Once you have those, meet me up by the entrance to Keldagrim, east of Rellekka. I'll be there with a boat to take us to our destination.

steps.player: Right, oak planks, steel nails, hammer, spade, east of Rellekka. Got it.
I don't think so.

options.text: Yes, I have all the materials.

steps.player: Yes, I have them with me.

options.text: What do I need to get?

steps.player: What do I need to get?

steps.text: If missing the planks:
If missing the nails:

steps.text: You have all the materials. Off to the iceberg!

options.text: Where should I meet you when I have everything?

steps.speaker: Larry

options.text: Oh, I know where to go.

first-trip-to-the-iceberg-with-a-fully-b.player: Can we start observing the penguins?

first-trip-to-the-iceberg-with-a-fully-b.speaker: Larry
first-trip-to-the-iceberg-with-a-fully-b.text: Yes. Let's get in and start observing. You should note down anything interesting the penguins do. I'll include it in my, uh, research.

first-trip-to-the-iceberg-with-a-fully-b.speaker: Larry
first-trip-to-the-iceberg-with-a-fully-b.text: Looks like the penguins are on patrol again.

first-trip-to-the-iceberg-with-a-fully-b.speaker: Larry
first-trip-to-the-iceberg-with-a-fully-b.text: They are organised! ORGANISED I tell you!

first-trip-to-the-iceberg-after-observin.speaker: Larry
first-trip-to-the-iceberg-after-observin.text: I knew it. I knew they were up to something! Did you see that? They were patrolling!

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: It isn't! They saluted and recognised each other. They're organised!

steps.player: It looked like one of them shivered and the other one just walked past. Nothing suspicious there, it is really cold here!

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: I don't care what you think. I know they are doing something. No one ever believes me. But I'll prove them wrong. ALL OF THEM.

steps.player: Okay, calm down. What do you think we should do now?
It did seem rather suspicious.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: You believe me?

steps.player: Of course! I mean, those penguins were acting quite strangely.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: No one ever believes me. Can I...hug you?

steps.player: Whoa there, I don't think this calls for hugging. What do we do next about the penguins?

steps.text: We need to get closer to the penguins. Infiltrate them. Learn what they are doing.

steps.player: How do you plan to do that?

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: We can't discuss it here; there are too many spies. Let's leave the iceberg and then I'll tell you my plans.

first-trip-to-the-iceberg-after-observin.speaker: Larry

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.player: How do you plan to infiltrate the penguins?

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: I have altered some designs of clockwork toys to make a clockwork penguin suit. We will use this to infiltrate their ranks.

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.player: What? We'll just set it off walking? What good will that do?

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: No! I'm going to use a spell to shrink you down so you can control it from the inside.

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.player: Wait a minute, why am I being shrunk? Why can't you get in the suit and annoy the penguins?

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: The penguins know my scent. They'd find me out and capture me and...torture me. No, it has to be you.

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: Don't worry. The spell only works if I'm nearby since I have to be constantly casting it. If trouble starts I'll be close by to help.

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: Here's the book. It has my designs and a list of things you need to get. Use your Crafting table at your house to build it, just like regular clockwork toys.

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.player: Why do I have to make the suit? I'm tired of doing all the legwork.

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: You have to make it, because since I got fired from the Zoo I've been homeless. Thanks for caring.

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.player: Oh, sorry... Hey, you told me you were on leave to do research!

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: Well...it's permanent leave, and I am doing research! When I used to work at the Zoo, I noticed the penguins doing odd things, like taking notes or timing things. I asked to have my work detail transferred to their cage and I was fired!

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: I'm sure the penguins are behind it. So I kept spying on them and I'll prove everyone wrong!

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.player: So that's why you can't wear the suit? Because you used to work near them?

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: Err, no. I've had a few run-ins since then. But I don't have time for war stories, we need to concentrate on our mission!

planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-speaking-to-la.text: When you're done making the suit, we'll head back to the iceberg and try it out.

steps.player: Yes, I have it.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: That's perfect. You are a very skilled crafter. Now we must return to the iceberg and test it.

steps.speaker: Larry

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: The book will explain how to make the suit. But, since you seem to lazy to read it, I'll summarise.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: Take the materials to your house and use the Crafting table to make clockwork toys. From there you can make the suit.

No, I'm not done yet.

planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.text: Look what they did to the bird hide! It's completely destroyed! The savages. The penguins are on to us.

options.text: I don't think it was the penguins.

steps.player: I don't think it was the penguins. You can't even make out the prints clearly, it could have been anything.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: Well of course you can't make out tracks. Penguins walk single file to hide their numbers! They're clever...so very clever.

options.text: It looks like a warning message to keep us away.

steps.player: It looks like a warning message to keep us away. I didn't think penguins were violent by nature.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: Oh, they act like they aren't, but it's all a guise. They wanted to scare us off. We must be on to something.

planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.player: Well, there aren't any penguins around now, so we can't try out the suit.

planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.text: But, we were so close to finding out what exactly is going on. It's all ruined now. How will we ever infiltrate them if there are none around to infiltrate?

planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.player: There are other penguins. What about the ones at the Zoo? At least we can test the suit on them.

planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.text: OF COURSE! You are brilliant. I should have thought of that. It's where all of this started. Let's return to the Zoo.

planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.text: I can teleport us back to the Zoo. It'll be faster.

planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.player: Then why the whole malarkey with the boat?

planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.speaker: Larry
planning-the-infiltration-second-iceberg.text: Boat rides lower my stress level.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.text: Well, a while back I was out in the field observing penguins. I worked for the Ardougne Zoo then. I was just quietly observing them when suddenly there was an avalanche.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.player: Larry, you are one unlucky dude.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.speaker: Larry
testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.text: I'm not done! I was trapped, but a passing old man stopped to help. He said he would shrink me so I could crawl out from under the weight of the snow.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.speaker: Larry
testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.text: Then he taught me the spell in case I would have need of it again.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.player: Seems like a pretty wise old man.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.speaker: Larry
testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.text: You see, that incident made me start suspecting the penguins, and my further work with them at the Zoo just confirmed it. I'm sure they got me fired. I know too much.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.player: Right, well we don't have all day. Time to be a penguin!

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.speaker: Larry
testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.text: Okay, but remember, if you move too far away from me the spell will break and you'll be normal sized again. Also, if you need to switch back, just ask me and I'll unshrink you.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-speaking-to-.player: Right, right. Let's just get this over with.

steps.text: What news do you bring? Have you made progress with the main directive?

steps.player: Uh, the main directive? Yeah...sure, I made progress with it. It was...easy?

steps.speaker: Penguin
steps.text: It was easy!? It was easy to learn how to FLY?

steps.player: Uh, yeah. I just kind of jumped off a hill and flapped a lot.

steps.text: Who cares? It's the entire reason we are in this wretched cage! We need to learn the secrets of flight, and the best way is to get these gullible humans to reveal it to us unwittingly. Blast them and their thumbs.

steps.player: You sound kind of bitter.

steps.speaker: Penguin
steps.text: Yes, I am. I'm tired of observing these humans and being gawked at by nasty little children. I miss the fresh codfish of our motherland.

steps.player: Anything I can do?

steps.speaker: Penguin
steps.text: You could take my mission report back to the outpost for me. I don't want to risk breaking out and blowing our cover.

steps.speaker: Penguin
steps.text: You should check in with the operatives in Lumbridge before you head to the outpost. They might have some news for you to take as well.

testing-the-suit-at-the-zoo-after-speaki.speaker: Larry

steps.text: Thank you comrade. This is like a taste of the motherland. The phrase is 'Do not trust the walrus.'

options.text: Hmm, no I'll hang on to it.

steps.player: Hmm, no I'll hang on to it.

steps.speaker: Penguin
steps.text: I am sorry comrade, but I cannot break protocol without good reason.

steps.speaker: Penguin
steps.text: Haa haa haa, that is a funny joke. I like your sense of humour comrade. It would be like asking 'Where is the motherland'.

steps.player: You mean they aren't the same?

steps.speaker: Penguin
steps.text: Haa haa haa... oh you have me in stitches.

finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.player: The Zoo penguin won't tell me the phrase.

finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.speaker: Larry
finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.text: Maybe there's something he wants, something you can trade for the phrase? Or maybe there's some kind of magic that would persuade him?

finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.speaker: Larry
finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.text: I once had to clean all the penguins feet, back when I had a job.

finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.speaker: Larry
finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.text: I distracted them by giving them cod fish and then did the job. It was gross.

finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.player: I don't think I ever want to be a Zoo keeper.

finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.speaker: Larry
finding-the-outpost-not-getting-the-phra.text: Or perhaps there's some sort of magic that could persuade the penguin? An object of power or the like?

steps.player: I need that phrase! Isn't there anything you can do?

steps.text: (See 'Asking the Zoo penguin the phrase' section above)
(See 'Asking the Zoo penguin the phrase' section above)

finding-the-outpost-after-obtaining-the-.player: I got the phrase! These penguins are so weird. It's something about a walrus.

finding-the-outpost-after-obtaining-the-.speaker: Larry
finding-the-outpost-after-obtaining-the-.text: You aren't taking this seriously! They are dangerous!

finding-the-outpost-after-obtaining-the-.speaker: Larry
finding-the-outpost-after-obtaining-the-.text: Oh, just go talk to the sheep.

finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.player: The penguin at the Zoo told me to see if you had any news.

finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.speaker: Sheep
finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.text: We can't get any news in this field! All these humans keep trying to shear us!

finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.speaker: Sheep
finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.text: We think the Farmer may be an agent for the other side, trying to have us assassinated by all these foolish humans. If you investigate him for us, we can finish our mission report and you can go on your way.

finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.player: You want me to disguise myself as a human and talk to the Farmer? Seems like a tough request. I'll only do it if you tell me how to get to the outpost.

finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.speaker: Sheep
finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.text: What do you mean 'How to get to the outpost'? Any intelligent penguin knows that.

finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.player: Are you calling me dumb? Fine. You can talk to the Farmer yourself, and compromise your mission.

finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.speaker: Sheep
finding-the-outpost-returning-to-the-she.text: No, no, we'll tell you. You just deal with the Farmer.

finding-the-outpost-speaking-with-fred.speaker: Fred the Farmer
finding-the-outpost-speaking-with-fred.text: What are you doing on my land?

options.text: I'm looking for something to kill.
I need to talk to you about penguins.

steps.player: I need to talk to you about penguins.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: About what now? What do penguins have to do with anything?

steps.player: Hey Fred! You've been messing with the wrong people. You better leave the penguins alone... OR ELSE!

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: What are you shouting about? Don't you come into my house shouting at me.

steps.player: I mean it Fred, I don't know whose side you're working for, but assassinating the penguin operatives is going to get you in trouble. To think you'd even stoop to sending others to try and 'shear' them. Be careful, or you might find you've been shorn.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Is this some kind of joke? I'm a SHEEP farmer. That means I need to shear sheep. What are these penguins you keep talking about?

steps.player: Don't play neutral with me, Fred. I see right through you. You're probably working for the squirrels, aren't you? I'll be watching Fred. I'm always watching.
You know that 'Thing' out in your field? It's two penguins in disguise.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Like I haven't heard that before.

steps.player: No really, it is! They're trying to observe humans to learn our weaknesses.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Then why are they disguised as sheep?

steps.player: They probably thought they'd blend in better. Anyway, I came to warn you to not annoy them too much. They're funny little guys but they seem to have a grudge against you.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: You talk to these penguins?

steps.player: Yes, I have a penguin suit and I know the secret greeting. I'm infiltrating them because this crazy guy Larry is convinced they are trying to take over the world or something.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Look, when these voices in your head start talking to you again, you might want to ignore them.

steps.player: HEY! I'm not crazy! Larry's a little left of centre, but I'm just helping him out. The penguins really can talk.

steps.speaker: Fred the Farmer
steps.text: Right, right. I believe you, sure. Maybe on your way out you could ask the sheep to herd themselves for me.

steps.player: Fine. Don't believe me. Larry and I will prove you wrong. Just don't go near the penguins, Fred, not if you value your life.

finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.speaker: Sheep
finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.text: Is the Farmer an agent for the other side?

options.text: The farmer is definitely an enemy.

steps.player: The Farmer is definitely an enemy. High ranking too, I think. He might even be the King of Lumbridge in disguise!

steps.speaker: Sheep
steps.text: King? I thought there was a duke, not a king.

steps.player: Well, that's why he's in disguise. Duh.

steps.speaker: Sheep
steps.text: This is an amazing revelation. We must include it in our report. Thank you, we'll mention your bravery.

steps.player: The Farmer is harmless. The sheep, however...now they seem pretty crafty.

steps.speaker: Sheep
steps.text: The sheep? But...They just wander around in this field all day. Trust us, we know.

steps.player: Exactly! So you don't suspect them! That's why they are so cunning. Watch your backs.

steps.speaker: Sheep
steps.text: You have a good point. Yes, we must warn Pescaling Pax of this new threat. We'll put it in the report and you can give it to them.

finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.player: Hey wait, you said you'd tell me where the outpost is!

finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.speaker: Sheep
finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.text: You are one clueless penguin. The outpost is the iceberg to the North. The entrance is concealed by what looks like an avalanche.

finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.speaker: Sheep
finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.text: When you try and go through a guard will stop you and ask for the password.

finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.speaker: Sheep
finding-the-outpost-reporting-back-to-th.text: The password is cabbage. Don't forget it.

finding-the-outpost-after-finding-the-ou.text: If the player told the penguins that Fred is a threat:

steps.player: I just convinced them Fred the Farmer was the King of Lumbridge!

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: But there is no King of Lumbridge.

steps.player: Exactly! They are so gullible. Even if they are organised.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: Don't take this so lightly. You might put Fred in danger because you were having a laugh.

steps.player: Sorry. It was just a bit of fun.

finding-the-outpost-after-finding-the-ou.text: If the player told the penguins that Fred is harmless:

steps.player: I just convinced the penguins that the sheep are agents for the other side.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: They are?

steps.player: No! They're just sheep. But I wanted to confuse the penguins. Put them off our scent.

steps.speaker: Larry
steps.text: What a good plan! I just hope the sheep aren't working for the other side.

steps.player: Larry, we need to get you to hang out with people, not animals.

finding-the-outpost-after-finding-the-ou.player: I know where their outpost is! The entrance is on the iceberg. It's concealed by an avalanche.

finding-the-outpost-after-finding-the-ou.speaker: Larry
finding-the-outpost-after-finding-the-ou.text: Great. Let's go back to the iceberg, I'll put you in your suit and we'll really see what these penguins are up to.

finding-the-outpost-after-finding-the-ou.prompt: Are you ready to go to the iceberg?

steps.text: Screen fades and the player is transported to the iceberg

steps.player: No.

entering-the-outpost-speaking-to-larry.speaker: Larry
entering-the-outpost-speaking-to-larry.text: Now you can try and enter the outpost. This is exciting.

entering-the-outpost-speaking-to-larry.player: It's fun for you! You're not risking your neck.

entering-the-outpost-speaking-to-larry.speaker: Larry
entering-the-outpost-speaking-to-larry.text: But you don't think penguins are dangerous anyway. So there's no danger is there? Or are you coming around to my thinking that they are dangerous?

entering-the-outpost-speaking-to-larry.player: No...I mean...yes. Oh never mind. Just do the spell. Wait, won't the spell wear off once I'm inside? You'll be too far away.

entering-the-outpost-speaking-to-larry.speaker: Larry
entering-the-outpost-speaking-to-larry.text: Oh, no. The ice magnifies this spell, so it will allow you to go greater distances.

entering-the-outpost-in-front-of-the-ent.player: This guy looks official. I'd better do the greeting before I speak to him.

entering-the-outpost-in-front-of-the-ent.target: Penguin emote interface in the control panel

steps.speaker: KGP Agent

entering-the-outpost-in-front-of-the-ent.text: After one out of three correct moves:

steps.player: Whew, that was right. Two more moves to do. If I get those right, he should speak to me.*

steps.text: No ID, no entry!

entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.player: The penguin at the entrance said I needed to have an ID. Nobody told me about any ID!

entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.speaker: Larry
entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.text: ID? But...they all look alike. Well, the other penguins probably just assumed you had it, since you said you were an agent.

entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.speaker: Larry
entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.text: You know, I met a rather shifty looking penguin once, north of Miscellania. He was named after some sort of pasta...

entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.speaker: Larry
entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.text: Anyway, he worked for a black market. Maybe he has a contact here who could get you an ID?

entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.speaker: Larry
entering-the-outpost-asking-larry-about-.text: Of course. Just look around here for a shifty pasta penguin.

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.speaker: Noodle
entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.text: I go' me sum hot 'wares, mate. Wotcha need?

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.player: Well, I've misplaced me, I mean my, ID card.

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.speaker: Noodle
entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.text: Ah, frisky nigh' on leave, eh? Betcha furgo' yur missin repor' 'oo.

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.player: Yeah, my missin repor'. I think I need one of them too.

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.speaker: Noodle
entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.text: Well, mate. 'U scratch me back, I stab urs, right?

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.speaker: Noodle
entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.text: I men' in a good way. I wan' sumpin in exy-change. Ima in need of sum swamp tur.

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.speaker: Noodle
entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.text: Thas wha' I sed, innit? I need sum feathers 'oo. Foive of 'em.

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.speaker: Noodle
entering-the-outpost-obtaining-an-id-fro.text: Yea, begreat. Then I'll guv yea 'ur stuff.

steps.player: Yeah, I got it.

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-entry-per.speaker: KGP Agent

entering-the-outpost-obtaining-entry-per.speaker: KGP Agent

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: If the player character is male:

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: Peach? But, aren't you...male?

steps.player: It was either that or Pear.

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: Ah. Of course.

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: If the player character is female:

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: Pablo? But, aren't you...female?

steps.player: Hippie parents, sir. They had weird ideas about names.

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.speaker: KGP Agent
inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: So you have just returned from your mission?

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.player: Yes, and I have my mission report. I also have the mission reports from the operatives in the Ardougne Zoo and the Lumbridge sheep field.

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.speaker: KGP Agent
inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: How very industrious of you, agent. Please hand them over.
Mission report (Ardougne), Mission report (Lumbridge), Mission report (fake)

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.speaker: KGP Agent
inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: It says you jumped off a hill and flew? Without assistance?

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.player: Oh yeah. It was amazing. You know, I just...flapped. Really fast.

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.speaker: KGP Agent
inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: Hmm, we shall have to research this.
If the player has completed Between a Rock...:

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: Did you really get launched out of a cannon? It seems quite risky.

steps.player: It wasn't too bad. I was wearing a helmet at the time.

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: This could be very useful during battle.

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: If the player has completed Enlightened Journey:

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: You flew in a 'hot air balloon'? What is that exactly?

steps.player: Well, it was a sack of cloth with a basket attached to the bottom and when you filled it with hot air it went up.

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: Fascinating. Well done agent.

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.speaker: KGP Agent
inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: I am satisfied with your reports. You just need to complete a physical and you will be free to roam at your leasure.

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.player: A physical? What, are they going to examine my body?

inside-the-outpost-debriefing.speaker: KGP Agent
inside-the-outpost-debriefing.text: Oh no. It's an agility course to make sure you're still fit and able to serve. Don't worry, I'm sure you won't have any difficulty getting through it. Just go through the door at the end of the room.

inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.speaker: Agility Instructor
inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.text: Well done soldier! You've successfully completed the physical. You're free to do as you like.

inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.speaker: Agility Instructor
inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.text: Just go through the gate in the fence and use the same door you came out of. You can come back whenever you like to tone up your body.

inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.player: All those penguins, what are they doing?

inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.speaker: Army Commander
inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.text: Ah, they are doing drills! Getting ready for the invasion. What a glorious day that will be!

inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.speaker: Army Commander
inside-the-outpost-finishing-the-agility.text: Yes, yes, I know we all get excited. But, I need you to get out of the way. Move along!

inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.player: Larry, you were right! There's an entire army of them, and they're drilling and... Larry, they're ORGANISED!

inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.speaker: Larry
inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.text: That's what I've been saying from the start! But an entire army? This is just an outpost, so it can't be an entire army.

inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.player: I know what I saw! They were doing drills and everything.

inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.speaker: Larry
inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.text: Still, it must only be an invasion party. The main force is on...well, it doesn't matter right now.

inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.speaker: Larry
inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.text: I've been doing some research of my own, and I think I know what our next step should be. There's a secret room, deep in the glacier. I think that is where they are making their war plans.

inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.player: War plans! Who are they going to war with?

inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.speaker: Larry
inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.text: With us, you dolt! They are trying to take over the world. Have you not grasped this yet? You need to find that room. Our future depends on it.

inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.speaker: Larry
inside-the-outpost-reporting-to-larry-af.text: It's probably the most well guarded room in the place. You'll need to find a way to get into it without arousing suspicion.

searching-for-the-secret-room-speaking-t.speaker: Larry
searching-for-the-secret-room-speaking-t.text: What are you doing out here! You need to get in there and find the secret room.

searching-for-the-secret-room-speaking-t.player: Keep your shorts on; I'm working on it.

searching-for-the-secret-room-talking-to.player: You there, let me through those doors.

searching-for-the-secret-room-talking-to.speaker: KGP Agent
searching-for-the-secret-room-talking-to.text: I'm sorry comrade, you do not have the clearance to go through these doors.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.player: You look like...knowledgeable...penguins. What's through those doors at the end of the hall?

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Pong
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Hey man, don't stress. Those doors open new worlds, man. Like, new rooms too.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.player: Yes, well, I would like to know what rooms.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Ping
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Like, the War Room and stuff like that, dude. Wicked stuff. Too bad only 'the man' gets to go through.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Pong
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: No, man. He just means the authority. The MAN, you know?

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.player: Who are you? You don't really look like KGP agents.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Ping
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Dude, we are bards. We sing of the glories of the common penguin. We are also supposed to record history, but man, it is so HIS story. Like, the MAN's story.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Ping
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Totally, dude. You want to hear one of our songs?

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.player: Sure, I haven't got anything to lose, except my eardrums.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Pong
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Well, like, we can't play it in THIS now. Maybe at a later now. We don't have any instruments to accompany our great song.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.player: But this room is filled with instruments.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Pong
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Yeah man, but they come from the south, where humans have thumbs to play them with. We don't have thumbs. Also, the Pescaling had our old ones confiscated for being too loud.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Ping
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: But dude, I was reading, and there are instruments we could play. I read about one called bongos. They just need to be hit.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Pong
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: But we need two instruments, man. Like, to make it harmonious with the vibes.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.player: What about a cowbell? You don't need thumbs for that.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Pong
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Righteous man. So you'll get a cowbell and bongos for us and we'll rock out. We'll be so harmonious, no Pescallion could complain.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.player: Wait, why am I getting these instruments?

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Pong
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Because your aura says you should.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.player: I think I have a lead. These two penguin bards seem to know a lot of the history of the iceberg. I think they might know a way into the War Room.
Where would I get a cowbell or a set of bongos?

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Larry
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: I'm not even going to ask why.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Larry
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: I think dairy cows have bells, you could steal one from it. Bongos... I suppose you could make them? Mahogany is good for bending, and then just use soft leather for the drum.

searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.speaker: Pong
searching-for-the-secret-room-asking-pen.text: Man, did you bring the instruments to us?

options.text: What did I need to get you?

steps.player: What did I need to get you?

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: We want a cowbell and a set of bongos.

steps.player: Yes.

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: You didn't bring the instruments.

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: You didn't bring the bongos.

steps.speaker: Pong

steps.text: Wait, wait. It needs more cowbell.

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: You're right, man. Let's try this again!
(Ping and Pong begin playing their instruments)

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: There once was a Pescallion, who travelled in a galleon.

steps.speaker: Ping
steps.text: Our Pescallion went exploring and found this iceberg

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: He travelled the world, until his toes curled.

steps.speaker: Ping
steps.text: Upon an iceberg he came, and our lives were never the same.

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: As an outpost it was approved, so here our people moved.

steps.speaker: Ping
steps.text: To grow and learn, though our hearts did yearn...

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: For the motherland.

steps.speaker: Ping
steps.text: Deep inside the 'berg lay a threat, but don't fret!

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: For Pescaling Pax trapped those monsters behind a gate, but let's hope they don't mate.

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: Now we have no fear

steps.speaker: Pong
steps.text: But shed a small tear for the motherland.
(The gate's KGP Agent enters the room)

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: All right, that's enough racket.

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: Shut those instruments up or I'm throwing you in solitary!

steps.speaker: KGP Agent
steps.text: I don't care if your vibes are harmonious!

steps.player: Now might be a good time for me to slip out and get through those doors...

steps.text: (Player quietly leaves the room)
End of cutscene

steps.player: No.

searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.text: A cutscene shows the player being caught

searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.speaker: Pescaling Pax
searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.text: And we'll move this little penguin here...and KABLOOM! Heee hee.

searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.speaker: Pescaling Pax
searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.text: It appears we have a visitor!

searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.speaker: Pescaling Pax
searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.text: Haa haa! I am glad we installed that anti-magic security. What have we here?

searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.speaker: Pescaling Pax
searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.text: What an ingenious little device. This will solve all our problems. Scientists! Come examine this; we have much work to do.

searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.speaker: Pescaling Pax
searching-for-the-secret-room-entering-t.text: Hmm, take that human to the Ice Lords. They'll enjoy the exercise.

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.speaker: Larry
finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.text: You're safe! I was really worried for a while there. What happened?

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.speaker: Larry
finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.text: Yes, yes, you're very brave. I mean what happened in the War Room?

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.player: Pescaling Pax was there, and he forced me out of the suit and then threw me into a cage with the Ice Lords!

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.speaker: Larry
finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.text: But what was IN the War Room?

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.player: There was a map of the world and a lot of little penguin figures.

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.speaker: Larry
finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.text: YES! I knew it! I said I'd prove them all wrong. They are organised and invading. OH YEAH, Larry was right. Who was right? Larry was!

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.player: LARRY! We've just uncovered a plot that could destroy everything we hold dear. Don't you think we should focus on stopping them?

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.speaker: Larry
finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.text: You are such a buzz kill.

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.player: We need to plan our next move, but now they know both our scents and might come after us!

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.speaker: Larry
finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.text: No, they only know mine. That agility course really stank up the suit and seems to have covered your scent. You might want to consider bathing soon.

finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.speaker: Larry
finishing-up-after-escaping-the-ice-lord.text: As for our next move, I've got...friends...elsewhere who should hear of this information, but we have plenty of time. It's not as though they made a break through in their research or something.
The screen fades into a brief cutscene showing a giant penguin suit under construction within their outpost before returning to the player.

extras-interacting-with-the-destroyed-hi.player: The hide was destroyed. It's too damaged to rebuild, so we can't use it to observe penguins any more.

extras-trying-to-manually-unequip-the-pe.text: You appear to be stuck and need Larry's help to get out of the suit.

extras-attempting-to-speak-to-sheep-as-a.player: I can't speak to the penguins when I'm not in my disguise.

extras-trying-to-use-the-shortcut-near-f.text: You can't use a stile when in the penguin suit.

extras-when-caught-as-a-human-at-the-ice.text: The KGP thinks you are a threat.

extras-when-caught-as-a-human-at-the-ice.speaker: KGP Agent
extras-when-caught-as-a-human-at-the-ice.text: There's been a breach! Red alert!
(The player is knocked down and transported to the iceberg entrance next to Larry)
As soon as the player moves:

steps.player: Urrrrrgh!

steps.text: You fail to steal a cowbell.
The cow kicks you and stuns you!
(The player takes some damage.)

steps.speaker: Dairy cow
steps.text: MOO

extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.speaker: Dairy cow
extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.text: What are yooo interrupting me for? Can't you see I'm working here?

extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.speaker: Dairy cow
extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.text: Moo, what do yoooou think you're doing?

extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.player: Err... Nothing. Just checking that your cowbell was working. Don't want you to get lost!

extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.speaker: Dairy cow
extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.text: How exactly am I going to get lost when I'm tied down? What were yooo really doing?

extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.player: I don't think you'll believe me.

extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.speaker: Dairy cow
extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.text: I'm a talking cow, I'll believe almost anything.

extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.player: Fine. I need the bell to trick some penguins into helping me get into their secret lair.

extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.speaker: Dairy cow
extras-stealing-a-cowbell-from-a-dairy-c.text: Well why didn't you say so? I've got a ton of these things. Go ahead and take the bell.

extras-making-the-bongos.text: You use the leather and plank to create penguin bongos.

extras-trying-to-leave-the-ice-lord-cage.text: The Ice Lords prevent your escape.
